premises.text: Consumers can top up and manage a connected transit card from phone/cloud anytime/anywhere, gaining ease and control
premises.evidence_span: They can top up their card while on their way to the bus, while waiting for the bus from the hotel room or even from their home city

premises.text: Public transport operators can sell tickets without physical sales infrastructure because every phone becomes a sales channel, and the card integrates into existing MyFair-based systems (~70% of contactless ticketing)
premises.evidence_span: You don't need a physical infrastructure for that. Instead, every phone becomes a sales channel

premises.text: Business model takes a percentage of ticket sales; distribution starts via public transport operators (e.g. Oyster-scale reach)
premises.evidence_span: we intend to sell a lot of tickets and take a percentage on those

premises.text: Fidesmo is also an API/platform for third parties to add services (loyalty, hotel keys, secure cloud access) on the same card/platform
premises.evidence_span: Fidesmo is, at the core, an API. We invite other companies to build services on top of our platform

domains.name: cloud-managed transit card for riders and PTOs

value.text: One connected card managed from the cloud that simplifies transit ticketing and can extend to other everyday services
value.evidence_span: We will make one card to replace them all

causal_links.evidence_span: It's also easy to implement, because the Videsmo card integrates seamlessly into their existing infrastructure
The Fidesmo card will reach the hands of the consumers via public transport operators
we will distribute additional services using open APIs
